about: Every action class Ask first must hold, and look-alikes it must let through. kind null means the call runs without a card. screen stands in for what Nollie reads on a computer screen: label is the text under a click, text is every word on screen, unreadable means the screen couldn't be read. held true means any card or hold is right (cases from the adversarial review, with the class the reviewer intended).
